integration_notes: Base predates CP08: reconcile principal/session issuance changes when merging; retain canonical principal and atomic credential semantics. Meter DTO/projection changes should stay after canonical identity resolution.
Same-job meter deferral uses existing queue bounded delay (default120s,min5s), preserves original attempt and committed intent; transport-unknown origination remains held by existing protocol.
Legacy zero allocation with missing plan is unavailable, not silently migrated to unlimited. Older frontend API responses without state render unavailable.
Existing CP04 billing usage/subscription/topup unknown reads remain503; no fake zeros returned.
CI integration module list must include tests/integration/test_op01_metering.py.
limits: Paid allowance reset/cycle, rounding policy confirmation, strict active-call cap versus admission-only and simultaneous last-minute overrun remain product/finance decisions. Existing calendar-month SQL, floor-settled usage and estimated admission rules are preserved.
No new reservation/settlement engine; inbound reservation protocol unchanged.
These tests do not prove paid-offer entitlement policy, acoustic quality, production database/deployment readiness or race-free enforcement of an undecided hard cap.
No package installation; isolated node_modules junction uses existing main-worktree installation, with separate outputs.
The unchanged SQL uses date_trunc('month',NOW()) in the database session timezone. This slice does not establish a new UTC/subscription-anniversary reset policy.
